'''Nela al'Caar''' is a [[Two Rivers]] woman and the wife of [[Paet al'Caar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nela al'Caar}}

== Appearance ==
She is long-faced with a long gray braid.

== Activities ==
During [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s testing for [[Accepted]], she sees a version of Nela who has become unstable from grief due to her husband's and sons' death.{{ref/book|2|23}}

[[Perrin Aybara]] helps her to organize the children before the [[Trolloc]] attack.{{ref/book|4|45}}
